turns.words: Ash, the roads are getting dangerous. Will you join me as my companion and fight at my side?
turns.prose: The hearth crackles in the center of Hearth, casting a warm glow on the wooden beams and the faces of Ash and Wren. Ash, a human fighter, stands by the door, their hand resting on the hilt of their longsword, ready to depart. Wren, another human fighter, approaches with a determined look, their own longsword at their side. Wren's voice is steady as they speak, "Ash, the roads are getting dangerous. Will you join me as my companion and fight at my side?" "Yes, I will come. The roads are indeed treacherous, and I believe we can watch each other's backs." Ash nods, their eyes reflecting the firelight, and they move towards the door, their boots echoing on the wooden floor as they prepare to face the dangers ahead.
